notes.title: v3.0 IS HERE!
notes.content:
[olist]
[*]Localisations for Korean and Chinese (simplified and traditional)!
[*][b]90+ total charts![/b]
[list]
[*]Around 15 more charts each for Easy and Normal difficulties -- now more beginner friendly!
[/list]
[*][b]More than 35 total songs![/b]
[list]
[*](New song) Reku Mochizuki “INFiNiTE ENERZY -Overdoze-”
[*](New song) DJ Kordai “C4”
[*]And loads more EDM! All bops!
[/list]
[*] [b]Revamped visuals and UI tweaks![/b]
[list]
[*]Improved visibility of notes and judges!
[*]Visual effects based on your combo!
[*]We have a search bar! Woo!
[/list]
[/olist]

notes.title: Full Release patch notes!
notes.content:
We're finally out of early access! The changes in the full version are listed below:

[list]
[*]overhauled visuals
[*]brand new UI
[*]a lot of new charts!
[*]a stats tracker
[*]crosshair customisation
[*]random play
[/list]

More to come in the biweekly updates!

notes.title: Glixch City Score Attack Contest!
notes.content: It's time for the biweekly score attack contest! The player with the highest score, AND a randomly chosen lucky player will win a reward! To enter, simply record your gameplay and tweet us. Details here: [url=https://twitter.com/beataimer/status/1593196077909671938]https://twitter.com/beataimer/status/1593196077909671938[/url]

notes.title: Shooty Spooky Score Attack Contest!
notes.content:
To celebrate Halloween and the release of our game, we're holding a Score Attack Contest, where the player with the highest score wins a reward! To enter, simply record your gameplay and tweet us. Details here: [url=https://twitter.com/beataimer/status/1585308202266021896]https://twitter.com/beataimer/status/1585308202266021896[/url]

As always, happy beat-aming!

notes.title: Shooty Spooky!
notes.content: Happy Halloween! We've made a Halloween-themed map and chart, and you can play it right now! Simply click on the button at the top of the song selection menu to play.
